findings.expected: The page scrolls wherever the pointer is; the sidebar only scrolls itself when it is shorter than its content
findings.actual: overscroll-behavior:contain on the aside (a scroll container because of overflow-y:auto) stops scroll chaining even when the aside has nothing to scroll (desktop and tablet: aside height == viewport).
